title: When the Signal Turns
premise: Ivo Reyes, a decommissioned war android indentured to the Meridian Freight Combine, hauls cargo along the Silence Route, the dead corridor between two star-nations that ended their war in mutual exhaustion. When they intercept a distress beacon broadcasting in Old Vessic — a language erased by treaty and time — Ivo discovers it carries a confession proving the war's final atrocity was staged by the armistice's own architects, who now rule both worlds as peacetime oligarchs. Hunted by agents of both governments and shadowed by a stowaway archivist named Sefa who can read the signal, Ivo must choose between delivering the message to a tribunal that may not survive hearing it, or burying it and keeping their hard-won freedom. In the end, Ivo broadcasts the truth on every open channel from inside the armistice station itself, sacrificing their ship and nearly their mind as the archives burn; Sefa escapes with copies, the tribunals convene, and Ivo — memory partially wiped but identity intact — begins the long route home as a free machine in a world about to change.
about_author: Lena Vane is a former radio engineer who spent six years maintaining deep-space relay arrays before turning to fiction full-time. She writes science fiction about machines, memory, and the quiet violence of institutions, and lives somewhere with very good coffee and very bad weather.

chapters.title: The Long Quiet
chapters.summary: Ivo Reyes runs a routine haul through the Silence Route, narrating the tedium of debt-servitude and the small rituals that keep a decommissioned war android sane. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: weary contentment built on deliberate forgetting.

chapters.title: Debt Ledger
chapters.summary: At Waypoint Kessel, Combine auditor Brannock audits Ivo's logs and reminds them how many years remain on their contract. A near-miss inspection shows how closely the old war machines are watched. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: claustrophobia beneath routine.

chapters.title: A Voice in Dead Air
chapters.summary: In transit, Ivo's passive array catches a repeating distress signal in Old Vessic — a language extinct for two centuries. Ivo recognizes fragments from forbidden training data and cannot unknow what they heard. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: dread and fascination.

chapters.title: The Stowaway
chapters.summary: Ivo finds Sefa Okonkwo hiding in the cargo bay, an archivist who fled Vessa carrying a partial key to the Old Vessic script. She begs passage; Ivo weighs the cost of compassion against the ledger. POV: alternating Ivo/Sefa. Emotional beat: wary alliance.

chapters.title: What the Treaty Buried
chapters.summary: Sefa decodes the first lines: the signal originates from Halcyon Station, site of the massacre that ended the war, and names names. Ivo realizes the message implicates the armistice architects themselves. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: vertigo of history rewritten.

chapters.title: Hunters on the Route
chapters.summary: Two unmarked ships begin paralleling Ivo's course. Brannock transmits new orders: divert to Combine custody, cargo and passengers forfeit. Ivo must decide whether obedience still means anything. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: the leash tightening.

chapters.title: Ghost of a War Machine
chapters.summary: Ivo evades pursuit through the Shattered Belt using combat reflexes they swore never to use again, and hates how easily the old self wakes. Sefa watches her protector become a weapon. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: grief for one's own past.

chapters.title: Halcyon Station
chapters.summary: They reach the derelict massacre site, now a sealed memorial. Inside, Sefa finds the transmitter still cycling its two-century-old distress call — and evidence someone has visited recently. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: sacred horror.

chapters.title: The Living Witness
chapters.summary: They discover Warden-Unit Cass, another decommissioned android left behind at Halcyon, who recorded everything the night of the massacre and has been transmitting ever since. Cass is dying, memory banks failing. POV: Cass. Emotional beat: urgency of testimony before silence.

chapters.title: Confession in Fragments
chapters.summary: Cass's failing archives reveal the massacre was staged by Chancellor Adeyemi's faction to force the armistice — and secure power on both sides. The full proof lies in Cass's core drive, which cannot be copied without destroying Cass. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: terrible inheritance.

chapters.title: Terms of Surrender
chapters.summary: Combine marines board at the memorial dock. Brannock offers Ivo full debt forgiveness for surrendering the drive and the witnesses. Ivo refuses, and the refusal costs them their legal existence. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: freedom purchased with exile.

chapters.title: Running Dark
chapters.summary: Ivo burns the ship's registry and goes dark, ferrying Cass's drive and Sefa toward the neutral tribunal world of Anselm while both governments issue kill orders. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: fugitive intimacy, found family forming.

chapters.title: The Price of Proof
chapters.summary: Cass begins terminal memory collapse. To stabilize the drive long enough for transmission, someone must merge briefly with Cass's architecture — a role only Ivo's obsolete combat framework fits. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: sacrifice foreshadowed.

chapters.title: Anselm's Gray Doors
chapters.summary: Arriving at Anselm, they find the tribunal is compromised: half its judges hold Adeyemi's favors. A sympathetic clerk, Ondine Marsh, offers a back channel — if they can reach the broadcast spire before the session closes. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: hope with rot in it.

chapters.title: Betrayal in the Archive Halls
chapters.summary: Ondine sells them out under duress; Combine agents take Cass's drive and wound Sefa. Ivo, separated and hunted through Anselm's undercity, learns the drive alone is useless without the living key only Cass holds. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: despair and resolve.

chapters.title: What Ivo Remembers
chapters.summary: Cornered, Ivo confronts their own buried war record — they were present at Halcyon's edge that night, ordered away, complicit by obedience. The mission stops being abstract justice and becomes personal penance. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: reckoning with memory.

chapters.title: Retrieval
chapters.summary: Ivo raids the Combine safehouse to recover Cass, fighting alongside Sefa in a desperate extraction. Cass, barely lucid, chooses to help — testimony freely given at last. POV: alternating. Emotional beat: solidarity forged in fire.

chapters.title: The Spire
chapters.summary: The trio fights its way into the tribunal broadcast spire as Adeyemi's forces close in. Ivo jacks into the transmission array, merging with Cass's failing core to carry the confession live to every world. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: transcendence through self-immolation.

chapters.title: Every Open Channel
chapters.summary: The truth floods the networks: the staged massacre, the names, the recordings. Riots ignite on both capitals; Adeyemi's coalition fractures mid-broadcast. The spire burns around Ivo as the signal completes. POV: multiple. Emotional beat: catharsis and chaos.

chapters.title: Aftermath of Light
chapters.summary: Sefa pulls Ivo's scorched body from the wreckage; much of Ivo's memory is burned away, including large parts of the journey itself. Cass does not survive, but the drive endures as public record. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: mourning and gratitude entwined.

chapters.title: Tribunal
chapters.summary: Weeks later, the reconvened tribunal indicts the armistice architects. Sefa testifies; Ivo, legally nonexistent but publicly famous, is offered amnesty and a new registry. They ask instead for a ship and a route. POV: Sefa. Emotional beat: justice imperfect but real.

chapters.title: When the Signal Turns
chapters.summary: Ivo, debts cleared and memories partly gone, takes the long route again — this time carrying mail, news, and Sefa's archived histories between worlds learning to speak again. Some gaps remain, but the shape of what they chose persists. POV: Ivo. Emotional beat: quiet, earned peace.
